## ultraleichter Elektro- rollstuhl AeroCarbon

Der AeroCarbon – unser ultraleichter Premium-Elektrorollstuhl aus modernster Kohlefaser-Technologie.

 

Mit nur knapp über 12 kg Eigengewicht ist er einer der leichtesten Carbon E-Rollstühle auf dem
Markt. Trotzdem überzeugt er mit außergewöhnlicher Stabilität, elegantem Design und einer
Verarbeitung, die höchsten Ansprüchen genügt. Ob in der Stadt, auf Reisen oder im Alltag – der
AeroCarbon bringt Sie komfortabel und stilvoll ans Ziel.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient

## Imagine a healthier world

We believe the next generation won’t be defined by age, but by a world without heart attacks or
strokes. This is a world-changing mind-set we call Going for Zero™. We do our part through

  ###### Trusted Source
  
  We are a trusted source for over 2.5 million customers since 2000. To learn more about Vitality

* [Happy Customers]
  
  ###### Happy Customers
  
  See our customer testimonials or our excellent customer reviews on Trustpilot, Reseller ratings
  and the Better Business Bureau.

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

We envision a future where global health isn’t just a concept but a lived reality—where communities

### Position Paper

## Protecting Health in a Changing Climate

Climate change represents the greatest health threat of the 21st century, with far-reaching
implications for human health across Europe and globally. The European Society of Medicine
recognizes the urgent need for coordinated action to protect public health from the escalating risks
posed by our changing climate.

### Policy framework

## A New Approach to Addressing Undervaccination in Europe

Europe must unite in its efforts to address undervaccination. The stakes are high, and the time to
act is now. We are calling upon the medical community to participate in this initiative and submit
research which strengthens its objectives.

[ Download ][116]
[ Read more ][117]

## Membership

The European Society of Medicine is more than a professional association. We are a community. Our
members work in countries across the globe, yet are united by a common goal: to promote health and
health equity, around the world.

No matter where you are in your career there is a place for you in the ESMED community.

[ Learn about membership ][118]

## The Medical Research Archives

The Medical Research Archives is the official journal of the European Society of Medicine.

Since its inception in 2014, the journal has published groundbreaking research, insightful reviews,
and compelling case reports addressing health issues of interest to a global community of medical
professionals.

## Author spotlight

Dr. Mahua Dey is the director of the surgical neuro-oncology program at the University of Wisconsin

cord tumors.

## Theme Issues

### Theme Issue

## Challenges and Opportunities in Health Disparities

Health disparities remain a pressing global concern, shaped by the interplay of socioeconomic
status, geography, race, ethnicity, and access to healthcare. This theme issue explores the complex
challenges that perpetuate inequities in health outcomes, while also highlighting emerging
opportunities to bridge these gaps.

[ Read more ][131]

### Theme Issue

## Innovations in Digital Health

The digital health landscape is rapidly evolving, driven by advances in technology, data science,
and patient-centered care models. This theme issue showcases innovations spanning from artificial
intelligence and predictive analytics to mobile health applications, wearable sensors, and
telemedicine. Together, these tools are redefining how healthcare is delivered, monitored, and
personalized.

[ Read more ][132]

### Theme Issue

## Implementation and Impact of Vaccination and Infectious Disease Control in Low-Resource Settings

Infectious diseases remain a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, disproportionately
affecting populations in low-resource settings where healthcare infrastructure and public health
outreach are limited. This issue features articles exploring vaccination, infectious disease
control, and technology-driven surveillance in these environments.

## The Global Health Center

The European Society of Medicine’s Global Health Center works to address the world’s most pressing
health challenges and inequities.

We envision a future where global health isn’t just a concept but a lived reality—where communities
worldwide benefit from shared knowledge, coordinated action, and collective advocacy. Together,
we’re working to ensure that better health becomes achievable for everyone, everywhere.

### Position Paper

## Protecting Health in a Changing Climate

Climate change represents the greatest health threat of the 21st century, with far-reaching
implications for human health across Europe and globally. The European Society of Medicine
recognizes the urgent need for coordinated action to protect public health from the escalating risks
posed by our changing climate.

### Policy framework

## A New Approach to Addressing Undervaccination in Europe

Europe must unite in its efforts to address undervaccination. The stakes are high, and the time to
act is now. We are calling upon the medical community to participate in this initiative and submit
research which strengthens its objectives.

## Membership

The European Society of Medicine is more than a professional association. We are a community. Our
members work in countries across the globe, yet are united by a common goal: to promote health and
health equity, around the world.

No matter where you are in your career there is a place for you in the ESMED community.

## Theme Issues

### Theme Issue

## Challenges and Opportunities in Health Disparities

Health disparities remain a pressing global concern, shaped by the interplay of socioeconomic
status, geography, race, ethnicity, and access to healthcare. This theme issue explores the complex
challenges that perpetuate inequities in health outcomes, while also highlighting emerging
opportunities to bridge these gaps.

[ Read more ][131]

### Theme Issue

## Innovations in Digital Health

The digital health landscape is rapidly evolving, driven by advances in technology, data science,
and patient-centered care models. This theme issue showcases innovations spanning from artificial
intelligence and predictive analytics to mobile health applications, wearable sensors, and
telemedicine. Together, these tools are redefining how healthcare is delivered, monitored, and
personalized.

[ Read more ][132]

### Theme Issue

## Implementation and Impact of Vaccination and Infectious Disease Control in Low-Resource Settings

Infectious diseases remain a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, disproportionately
affecting populations in low-resource settings where healthcare infrastructure and public health
outreach are limited. This issue features articles exploring vaccination, infectious disease
control, and technology-driven surveillance in these environments.

The principle of the mattress is to continuously exchange different pressure zones AB or ABC at set
times to achieve the effect of reducing pressure on the body surface and preventing bedsores.

### Pain & Inflammation Relief

The pressure distribution before and after use of the pressure chart can clearly show the effect of
the mattress on reducing pressure.

### Performance Enhancer

In clinical trials, there are cases where bedsores the size of an egg can be cured after using a
mattress for one month.

### Efficient Drug Delivery

Optimizes particle size for deep lung penetration and maximum therapeutic effect.

### Consistent Particle Sizing

Ensures reliable and consistent aerosol particle distribution for every treatment.

### Versatile Nebulizer Options

Offers a range of nebulizers to suit various patient needs and breathing patterns.

### Sequential Compression

4-6-8-chamber Phlebo Press DVT system ensures deep vein reperfusion .

### Pressure Regulation

Adjustable pressure range of up to 250mmHg for precise therapy and comfort .

### Size Options & Alarms

Various sizes from M to 5XL, with visual and audible alarms for safety .

* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

# Ingersoll Rand

As a global provider of mission-critical flow creation and life science and industrial solutions, we
are dedicated to Making Life Better for our employees, customers, shareholders, and planet

[
[Who we are teaser]

### Who We Are

Powered by an ownership mindset and 160 years of experience, we’re Making Life Better for our
employees, our customers, our shareholders, and our planet.

][75][
[Careers teaser]

### Careers

Looking to take the next step in your career? Come join us.

][76][
[Investors teaser]

### Investors

Find our latest press releases, earnings presentations, Annual Reports, and more.

][77]

## Key Brands

[
[IR logo grey right]

### Ingersoll Rand

Ingersoll Rand provides products, services and solutions that enhance our customers' energy
efficiency, productivity and operations. With over 160 years of air compressor knowledge and
expertise, you can trust Ingersoll Rand to provide you with a solution you can rely on.

][78]
[
[GD logo grey right]

### Gardner Denver

World leading supplier of compressors, blowers and vacuum pumps. We accelerate mission-critical
applications worldwide. With 160 years of experience, we are a leading global provider of
compressors, blowers, and vacuum pumps.

][79]
[
[Compair logo]

### Compair

Leading supplier of oil free and oil lubricated rotary screw, reciprocating, centrifugal and
portable air compressors. The company has been at the forefront of air compressor technology for
many decades & we now also produce our own in-house air treatment ranges to supply the complete
compressed air network package.

KAER's expertise is recognized for the invention and development of products that generate
high-concentration respirable aerosols from liquid APIs, complex biologics and advanced
formulations. Our AeroPulsR™ (aqueous aerosol) and SUPRAER™ (dry aerosol) systems enable the
generation and delivery of therapeutic aerosols adapted specifically to the pediatric or adult
patient's tidal volume (or target tissue) for optimum deposition. To facilitate minimum treatment
duration, our products generate aerosols at rates up to 10 times higher than existing nebulization
technologies. An important breakthrough achieved by KAER is that the payload integrity and
bioactivity of the generated aerosol are maintained following aerosolization across a wide range of
viscosities and molecular structures.

 

Novel potential agents in the pipelines become drugs when they are successfully delivered to resolve
the patient’s ailment. KAER invites corporations to evaluate the delivery of their APIs and
formulations with AeroPulsR™ and SUPRAER™. These potential entities and avenues are summarized

Automation – Industrial and Anti-infectives for Animal Healthcare

KAER aerosol technology fulfills three automation essentials: 1) repeatable aerosol plume quality,
2) accurate agent dosing, and 3) precise millisecond aerosol output control.

Unlike conventional atomizers and mesh nebulizers that recirculate the liquid, KAER’s aerosolizing
nozzles enable single-pass liquid flow, i.e. 100% of the liquid entering the nozzle is aerosolized
within a few microseconds. This process eliminates drug denaturing, clogging, dripping, or
overheating. The aerosol output quality, including the particle size, dose and plume volume, is
maintained throughout the aerosolization duration and each operation cycle.

Combined with practically unlimited drug container volume, the integrated drug dispenser enables the
delivery of precise dosimetry throughout the duration of the treatment procedure. This aspect of the
product is especially crucial for aerosol delivery in production lines and mass vaccination systems.

The AeroPulsR is fully compatible with existing pneumatic outlets in both clinical care as well as
industrial applications allowing seamless integration into patient care facilities or automated
delivery lines. The internal hardware and integrated electronics are designed to handle repeatable
or continuous aerosol delivery with millisecond precision.

A key application is animal health, wherein synchronized aerosol doses as crates of chicks moving
past fixed nozzle banks on conveyor lines, ensure uniform deposition of vaccine at line speed. For
adhesives and paints, collimated jets enable precise line coating and spot bonding on fast-moving
parts. When wide-area coverage is required, the system produces soft, uniform plumes for surfaces,
textiles, and packaging with minimal overspray.

Financing
Financing for Medical Practices

From new office builds and real estate loans to equipment financing and working capital , we can
help you get the right financial tools that your practice needs.

[
Learn More

Business Services
Medical Business Services

With our portfolio of business services and industry expertise, we can help you improve your
practice efficiency, reduce expenses, and increase your bottom line.

Learn More

Commercial Real Estate Financing
Commercial Real Estate Financing

Starting your own medical practice or opening a satellite office are often pivotable moments in any
doctor’s career. We can help provide you with favorable financing programs, that align with your
practice goals and personal ambitions.

[
Learn More
][30]
Contact Us
Dedicated to the needs of your practice

At Henry Schein Financial Services, we partner with practices to create a customized strategy
aligned to your unique practice goals. Contact our team to get started today.

Contact Us Today

[previous arrow]

Henry Schein Financial Services is dedicated to providing financial and business solutions built
around the needs of doctors,
so medical practitioners and practice owners can run and operate a more successful practice.

We provide a broad range of products and services that support practices of all sizes and stages
that are designed to help your practice grow, function more efficiently, reduce expenses, and
ultimately become more profitable while providing exceptional patient care. We work with doctors,
like you, to create customized strategies that will help you achieve your business goals and drive
even greater financial success, and with less need to focus on the financial side of your practice,
you can spend more time delivering quality patient care you are known for.

[[Medical Equipment Financing]][32]

### Financing, Loans, and Financial Solutions

Count on Henry Schein to help you get access to the financing^{* }and resources you need for your
medical practice. Whether you are starting a private practice from scratch, remodeling an existing
location, or purchasing equipment – we can get you the financing you need to achieve your practice
and business goals.

[Learn More][33]
[[Medical Business Services]][34]

### Business Services for Medical Practices

We are dedicated to providing health care practitioners like you with services that increase your
revenue and reduce the cost of doing business so that you can focus on providing quality care to
your patients.

[Learn More][35]
[[Medical Practice Financial Advisor]][36]

## We’re here to support medical practices, like yours

While you are an expert in practicing medicine, not all practice owners are expert business owners –
that’s where we come in. We are medical practice financing experts. Put our years of industry
expertise to work for your practice.

Whether you’re just getting started or a seasoned practice owner, we have tools and resources to
help you take your practice to the next level.

[Contact Us][37]

## Financial Services

From equipment financing and working capital to project remodeling loans and debt consolidation,
Henry Schein Financial Services has the financial tools for your practice.

## Your Trusted Source for Fire and Life Safety Equipment and Services

At MES Life Safety, we provide top-tier fire and safety equipment and PPE equipment to those who
protect and serve. Whether you're a fire chief, deputy, safety officer, or municipal leader, we
offer the gear, expertise, and service you need to stay mission-ready We don't just supply
equipment—we deliver confidence in the most critical moments. We understand the environments you
operate in because we've spent decades in the field, side by side with the men and women who run
toward danger. Our team brings deep, specialized knowledge of the life safety landscape—what works,
what lasts, and what's mission-critical when every second counts. We provide gear you can rely on
and insight you can't get anywhere else—backed by technical expertise and a no-compromise approach
to support. We proudly serve departments across the United States and Canada, offering personalized
support and a robust selection of products through our online store.

### Premium Gear. Proven Performance

From turnout gear and SCBAs to gas detection and PPE equipment, every product we offer is tested,
trusted, and ready for the front line. Our team of experts ensures that each item meets the highest
standards of safety and durability. We understand the complex needs of departments and safety
professionals. That's why we provide custom equipment packages, department outfitting services, and
one-on-one consultations—whether you're ordering for five or five hundred.

## Your Trusted Source for Fire and Life Safety Equipment and Services

At MES Life Safety, we provide top-tier fire and safety equipment and PPE equipment to those who
protect and serve. Whether you're a fire chief, deputy, safety officer, or municipal leader, we
offer the gear, expertise, and service you need to stay mission-ready We don't just supply
equipment—we deliver confidence in the most critical moments. We understand the environments you
operate in because we've spent decades in the field, side by side with the men and women who run
toward danger. Our team brings deep, specialized knowledge of the life safety landscape—what works,
what lasts, and what's mission-critical when every second counts. We provide gear you can rely on
and insight you can't get anywhere else—backed by technical expertise and a no-compromise approach
to support. We proudly serve departments across the United States and Canada, offering personalized
support and a robust selection of products through our online store.

### Premium Gear. Proven Performance

From turnout gear and SCBAs to gas detection and PPE equipment, every product we offer is tested,
trusted, and ready for the front line. Our team of experts ensures that each item meets the highest
standards of safety and durability. We understand the complex needs of departments and safety
professionals. That's why we provide custom equipment packages, department outfitting services, and
one-on-one consultations—whether you're ordering for five or five hundred.

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

[ Search now ][44]
[ Plug in our data ][45]

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## **Key offerings and exhibitors **at the REHACARE trade fair in Düsseldorf

## **Key offerings and exhibitors **at the REHACARE trade fair in Düsseldorf

Discover innovative products, services, and solutions from leading companies and experts in the
fields of rehabilitation, prevention, inclusion, and care. Whether you are looking for everyday
aids, mobility solutions, barrier-free living, or digital assistance systems, exhibitors from all
over the world will be presenting their latest developments for independent living at REHACARE. You
can also use the REHACARE exhibitor and product search to find specific providers and innovations
that interest you.
[ **Exhibitors & Products ❯** ][106]
 
[ [Photo: Eating aid that uses robotic technology] ][107]
[

### Daily living aids

Everyday aids in the Rehacare range help people with physical disabilities to organise their
everyday lives independently and safely.
][108]
[ To the exhibitors ][109]
[ [Photo: LVR and LWL stand with joint counselling services at REHACARE] ][110]

### Apprenticeship & Workplace

REHACARE International presents innovative approaches and solutions for the training, workplace and
professional inclusion of people with disabilities.
][111]

### Barrier free living

Barrier-free building and living creates living spaces that are accessible and comfortable for
everyone. The focus is on safety, independence and quality of life within your own four walls.
][114]
[ To the exhibitors ][115]

### Aids for children

Paediatric aids promote the mobility, development and participation of children with disabilities.
They are customised to their individual needs and make everyday life easier.
][117]

### Communication

Assistive devices enable people with disabilities to express themselves clearly and actively
participate in social life. They create bridges for more self-determination and participation.
][120]

### Medical care

Medical care in the rehabilitation sector ensures quality of life and promotes recovery. Individual
solutions and modern technology take centre stage.
][123]
[ To the exhibitors ][124]

Walking aids offer safety and mobility in everyday life for people with restricted mobility. They
promote independence and active participation in life.

Orthopaedic aids support mobility and stability in the event of physical limitations. They help to
alleviate pain and improve quality of life.

Training, physiotherapy and occupational therapy promote mobility and independence. Individualised

### Associations, organisations, nursing residents

Associations and organisations promote exchange, strengthen inclusion and advocate equal
opportunities and a self-determined life.

## **Program Overview**

## **Program Overview**

REHACARE offers a diverse and practical program that combines innovation, knowledge transfer, and
hands-on experiences. Visitors can expect an inspiring mix of expert forums, themed zones, and
interactive activities that bring the industry’s latest developments to life. Whether it’s the
latest products and technologies, social and political discussions, or hands-on sports
activities—the program creates space for exchange, orientation, and concrete insights into the
future of rehabilitation, inclusion, and care.

## International Trade Fair for Rehabilitation, Prevention, Inclusion, and Care

## **REHACARE** – International Trade Fair for Rehabilitation, Prevention, Inclusion, and Care

### **The hub for innovation, exchange, and participation**

**REHACARE** is the central meeting place for the international community dedicated to independent
living. Here, exhibitors from around the world showcase the latest products, services, and
innovations that make everyday life easier and enable active participation.

As the leading trade fair, **REHACARE** will set the standard for future-oriented topics in
rehabilitation and inclusion from **September 23–26, 2026 **— with its unique combination of a
high-caliber trade fair, practical forums, and inspiring encounters.


[More information for visitors][103] [More information for exhibitors][104]

## **Program Overview**

REHACARE offers a diverse and practical program that combines innovation, knowledge transfer, and
hands-on experiences. Visitors can expect an inspiring mix of expert forums, themed zones, and
interactive activities that bring the industry’s latest developments to life. Whether it’s the
latest products and technologies, social and political discussions, or hands-on sports
activities—the program creates space for exchange, orientation, and concrete insights into the
future of rehabilitation, inclusion, and care.

effective products at very competitive prices.

We are continuously looking for additional products that businesses and consumers are looking for
and bring them to market under our nationally known brands.

 

[Visit Our Store][113]

[Branded Products]

Veridian is synonymous with Private Label Solutions. We are experts at sourcing and developing
products for companies to use under their banners and logos. Our innovative marketing and regulatory
team assures that the products under Private Label meet all the objectives and standards necessary
for successful launch of private labeled products. Our expertise in distribution assures that
private labeled products are in-warehouse, available and ready to ship to DCs and stores quickly and
efficiently.

 

[View More][114]

[Private Labels]

Connected Care

Veridian has the largest full-line of connected devices in the market – allowing companies to single
source their connected device needs in both Bluetooth and cellular enabled devices at prices that
are very cost effective. Our standardized SDKs allow for inter-usability of devices within each
category without reintegrating a new or next generation device. Our cellular service allows for
simple point and click management of the cellular capability of the devices, including pause/resume
functionality for more cost effective care.
* [Our Connected Products][115]
* [Private Label][116]
* [Integrations][117]
* [Kitting/Logistics ][118]

Veridian offers the largest line of connected devices in the market, including BPs, Thermometers,
Pulse Oximeter, Scales, Glucometers, Fetal Dopplers, Activity Trackers, Pill Boxes, etc.).

All of our 510K registered devices are available in Bluetooth, and most are also available with
cellular services. Our cellular services allow for seamless data flow from the device to data
repositories and have a standard pause/resume function to save on cellular costs.

[View More][119]

Veridian offers the option to private label our connected devices including the device, the exterior
boxes/kits and inserted written materials.

This allows businesses to continually highlight their name and presence every time a user takes a
reading. Our product marketing team works with each project to assure that the look and feel of the
connected devices meets the desired experience for end-users.

[View More][120]

Our connected devices have standardized SDKs and uniform SIM cards to allow for seamless
connections. Once the SDK is integrated into the software platform, it is universal across all of
the devices in that class.

Our cellular service uses a simple registration for the devices and features a pause/resume function
to reduce un-needed cellular data costs. Our device integration team is ready to assist in any
aspect of configuration or enabling.

[View More][121]

Veridian offers a full range of device kitting and logistics that allow businesses to concentrate on
growing their business while we take on getting a device or set of devices picked, packed and
delivered. We offer drop-ship to end-user homes and bulk delivery to distribution centers or hubs.

Our team can customize any or all parts of the kitted solution including private labeling and
customized inserts – creating the experience you want for your customers.

[View More][122]

[View More][123]

Who We Serve

Veridian is a nationally known in the healthcare product B2B market. Our house branded products and
our private label products are distributed throughout the retail marketplace, including large and
small retail pharmacies, supermarkets, department stores, and e-retailers as well as large
distributor platforms that reach smaller community stores and businesses. Our connected care
division serves hospitals and health systems, insurance companies and innovative health delivery
companies.

connections. Once the SDK is integrated into the software platform, it is universal across all of

to reduce un-needed cellular data costs. Our device integration team is ready to assist in any

growing their business while we take on getting a device or set of devices picked, packed and
delivered. We offer drop-ship to end-user homes and bulk delivery to distribution centers or hubs.

customized inserts – creating the experience you want for your customers.

  [Silicone manual resuscitator ambu bag][107]
  
  Artificial emergency manual resuscitator, usually being called as Ambu bag or BVM-short for bag
  valve mask, is intended for providing positive pressure ventilation to patients who are not
  breathing or not breathing adequately.
* [[SEBS manual resuscitator ambu bag]][108]

  SEBS resuscitation bag single use ambu set is a handheld tool that is used to deliver positive
  pressure ventilation to any subject with insufficient or ineffective breaths.

  [PVC ambu bag resuscitator single use][111]

  Ambu bag or BVM-short for bag valve mask, is intended for pulmonary resuscitation.

  resuscitators and anesthesia machine.

  cervical rachis for a poly-traumatized patient during moving or transportation.

  cardiac arrest or respiratory arrest.

## ABOUT YUWELL

Yuwell - Jiangsu Yuyue Medical Equipment & Supply Co., Ltd., based in Shanghai, China, is the
leading manufacturer of medical equipment. The company was started in 1998 and has grown into a
professional expert in the manufacture of oxygen equipment, rehabilitation equipment, hospital
products and healthcare products. With a continued focus on R&D & quality, Yuwell brings advanced
healthcare products for hospitals, clinics and home use.


Impact Distributors, based in Hyderabad, India, is the Authorized Distributor for Yuwell products in
India. The company has an exclusive distribution and service center for Yuwell products.
